issues.explanation: The custom current_entity middleware protecting the Dashboard Livewire page is not registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it runs only on the initial page load and not on subsequent Livewire updates.

conventions.evidence: Domain write via app/Actions/CreateEntityWithOwner.php:48 authorizing inside action; Livewire #[Validate] + validate() in app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:215,220; policies via Gate in app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:100 and app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:309; #[Fillable] in app/Models/Entity.php:38; reversible migrations with down(); docs updated (database-schema, business-rules, CHANGELOG). One deviation: no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (uniqueSlug, slugTaken, membershipFor, actorHasRole/hasRole); clear names (ResolveCurrentEntity, CreateEntityWithOwner, CurrentEntity); consistent with sibling style; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: entities_slug_unique in database/migrations/2026_10_29_044040_create_entities_table.php:34 with SoftDeletes; owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_entity_user_unique + entity_memberships_one_owner in 2026_10_29_044041:873,876-877; EntityPolicy.php:612,617,622,628,632 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:551,560,570 match spec; ResolveCurrentEntity.php:162-177 0/1/>1 dispatch + 403; HomeController + routes/web.php:1150-1168 names/middleware; CreateEntity.php:230-245 retry loop calling uniqueSlug() each attempt + audit/session/redirect; Dashboard Locked + Gate; switcher.blade.php button is-fullwidth is-link/data-current="1" vs is-light; lang ui.switch_entity + onboarding titles both locales.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves task.md (models, policies, middleware, onboarding, switcher, dashboard, routes, langs, docs, tests); home.blade.php deletion follows /home repurposing; no members/settings/invitation/queue/billing code.

security.evidence: Gate::authorize view/create in EntityController.php:100, CreateEntityWithOwner.php:50, Dashboard.php:309; #[Validate] required|string|max:255 + validate(); #[Locked] Entity $entity in Dashboard.php:304-305 with tamper test; no client role input (PublicPropertyNotFound test); {{ }} escaping in switcher/dashboard; $fillable mass-assignment guard; pick aborts before session write so 403 leaves session untouched.

simplicity.evidence: One Action per use case, no service/repository layers; reuses belongsToMany/entities(), membershipFor(), policies; minimal slug logic with reserved switcher + withTrashed check; no speculative abstraction or duplication.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/CreateEntityTest.php (happy path, required validation, suffix -3, soft-deleted reserved, reserved switcher, fallback entity, insert-collision retry, bounded attempts, tamper role, throttle); EntityDashboardTest (member view, cross-entity view, 403 stranger, Locked tamper); EntityModelTest (DB uniques, one-owner, owner_seq, cascade); EntityPolicyTest (all view/update/delete/manageSettings/assignRole/delete branches); EntitySwitcherTest (only-user forms, current marking, navbar >1); TenantSessionTest (guests, verified, home 0/1/>1, 403 stale session, pick audit + forbidden untouched, POST-only).

review.summary: Implements entities/memberships with single-owner DB guard, tenant middleware, onboarding with collision-retry slugs, dashboard, switcher, and navbar plus comprehensive Pest tests. Requirements, security, tests, simplicity, readability, and scope are fully met; one minor conventions nit (missing Livewire persistent middleware for current_entity) keeps it at approve-with-nits.
